notes.title: New UI Changes!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=6f_6vb7ivqs;full][/previewyoutube]

During playtesting at various events such as GAMEMASON 2024 or our upcoming appearance at MagFest 2025, we found that the old 2D UI wasn't noticeable, clear, or communicative enough for many first-time players, so we decided to make some big changes. We hope that all players have a better time with the snazzy-new look we've set up for you. :3
